$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.query.format. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-AST-SLOT-DUPLICATED
arms.note: a declared type the projection also publishes as a child prints twice

arms.name: M-LINT-SUMMARY-ONE-SHAPE
arms.note: a summary of one rule names its top three files inline instead of a by-file breakdown

arms.name: M-LINTFORMAT-NO-DATA
arms.note: the json record drops the finding's identity, so nothing downstream can key by it

arms.name: M-LINT-FORMAT-DOMINATED
arms.note: the json envelope names no dominated lock

arms.name: M-LINT-FORMAT-ERRORPATH
arms.note: a reason blocking only through a catch carries no errorPath in json

arms.name: M-GRAPH-LABEL-MARKUP
arms.note: a vertex label goes out as markup, written raw, so `Map<String, Int>` renders as HTML and reads back as no plain text

arms.name: M-GRAPH-HTML-SCRIPT-UNCLOSED
arms.note: a `</script` inside the inlined library closes the element holding it, and the rest of the library spills into the page as text

arms.name: M-GRAPH-HTML-COMMENT-OPEN
arms.note: a `<!--` of the inlined library followed by `<script` keeps the page's own `</script>` from closing the element, and the page's script never runs

arms.name: M-GRAPH-MERMAID-CYCLE-HIDES-CHANGE
arms.note: a changed edge closing a cycle is drawn red after its change colour, so a comparison hides the change on every edge of a cycle

arms.name: M-FLOW-MERMAID-SHAPES
arms.note: a decision is drawn as a box like a statement, so a branch no longer reads as a question in the chart
